title: Empty Classroom Light & Fan Saver
title_te: ఖాళీ తరగతి గది లైట్ & ఫ్యాన్ సేవర్
problem: Classroom ceiling fans and lights keep running for hours when students go out for sports ground practice, wasting electricity.
idea: A camera that knows when the classroom is empty. If the room is empty but fans are on, it speaks a reminder to switch off. See how much power we can save.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What does the classroom camera see?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine checks the room. Tap what it sees.
widgets.question: The camera sees:

options.label: Students in class
options.result: Class in progress. Fans and lights are needed.

options.label: Empty room, fans OFF
options.result: Empty room and power is off. Well done! 🌱
options.te: ఖాళీ గది, కరెంట్ ఆఫ్. చాలా బాగుంది! 🌱

options.label: Empty room, fans ON
options.result: Room is empty! Last student, please switch off the fans and lights.
options.te: గది ఖాళీ! చివరి విద్యార్థి, ఫ్యాన్లు, లైట్లు ఆపండి.

widgets.heading: 🧮 How much power is wasted?
widgets.intro: Count the fans and lights left on in an empty classroom.

inputs.label: Hours on in an empty room each day

widgets.formula: if (typeof fans !== 'number' || typeof lights !== 'number' || typeof hours !== 'number' || typeof days !== 'number' || typeof rate !== 'number') return null; if (fans < 0 || lights < 0 || hours < 0 || days < 0 || rate < 0) return null; var watts = fans * 75 + lights * 40; var units = watts * hours * days / 1000; var money = units * rate; return {units: units, money: money, year: money * 10, level: units > 10 ? 'bad' : (units > 0 ? 'warn' : 'good')};

items.title: Last one out
items.text: The last student out switches off everything.

items.title: Use daylight
items.text: Open windows in the day instead of switching on lights.

items.title: Switch stickers
items.text: Stick 'Switch off!' labels above the switchboard.

how: In Teachable Machine (Image Project), make classes: Students present, Empty fans off, Empty fans on. Take about 40 photos of each from the same spot.
Train, Export and copy the model link.
In PictoBlox, add the Machine Learning and Text-to-Speech extensions.
If the class is 'Empty fans on' for more than 1 minute, speak 'Please switch off the fans and lights' in Telugu and English.
Use the calculator above to show the class how much money is wasted.
Ask Gemini for energy-saving slogans and stick them near the switchboards.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Write 5 short energy-saving slogans in English and Telugu to stick near classroom switchboards, reminding the last student to switch off fans and lights.
